info.description: SwiftRead turns articles and web pages into natural spoken audio. POST a page URL to /read-url and it fetches the page, extracts the article's main text (navigation and boilerplate stripped), and reads it aloud in a natural neural voice, returning audio/mpeg directly - the listen-to-this-article button as an API. POST raw text to /speak to hear your own content. Ten curated voices (US and UK, male and female) are listed at GET /voices, and an optional rate slows or speeds the reading. Every request is capped at 15,000 characters of text (roughly 15 minutes of speech; a long article can take tens of seconds to synthesize, so treat these as slow endpoints). Every failure is a structured JSON error that names the problem - over-cap text, no article text found on the page, an unknown voice - never a bare 503.

200.description: Service health, engine, limits, and endpoint list

rate.description: Optional speaking rate: a multiplier between 0.5 and 2.0, or a percent string like '-15%'. Clamped to -50%..+100%.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the article page to read aloud

200.description: The article read aloud as MP3 audio. Response headers report the voice, character count, chunk count, and the article title.

422.description: Structured JSON error: missing/invalid parameter, page refused (non-public address), no article text found, or extracted text over the 15,000-character cap (the error names the cap and the length received)

502.description: Structured JSON error: the source page failed or synthesis failed
